privacyReview.decisionSummary: Approve aggregate-only measurement using the existing bounded event labels. Keep client analytics disabled until a named consent-aware provider, consent behavior, public configuration evidence, and founder-gated connector activation are reviewed. Traffic, conversion, and revenue remain unknown until a complete observed export of at least seven days is imported.

connectors.name: Google Search Console aggregate export
connectors.nextGate: Founder verifies the site property and approves aggregate Search Console export access.

connectors.name: Consent-aware aggregate web analytics
connectors.nextGate: Founder approves the privacy posture, consent behavior, and aggregate event definitions before analytics is enabled.

connectors.name: Approved affiliate-network aggregate export
connectors.nextGate: Founder approves one affiliate program, its terms, tracking identity, registered site, and reporting export.

connectors.name: Official social-platform aggregate export
connectors.nextGate: Founder approves an official account, rights-cleared creative, cadence, and API access.

experiments.title: Pair or pile decision test
experiments.hypothesis: A decision-first social concept explaining why two gifts interact will earn more qualified visits than a generic collage of the same products.
experiments.decisionRule: Run only after an approved account and aggregate analytics exist; keep the concept only if it produces a higher engaged-session rate across a comparable seven-day window without increasing misleading or unsupported product claims.
stopConditions: Stop if the creative requires unlicensed product imagery or an unsupported experience claim.
Stop if the destination or tracking cannot be measured without collecting disallowed personal data.

experiments.title: Observed golf friction carousel
experiments.hypothesis: A carousel built around recognizable course-day workarounds will attract more qualified gift-planning visits than a headline centered on popular golf accessories.
experiments.decisionRule: After the official account and aggregate reporting are approved, compare distinct creative concepts over the same reporting window; advance only the concept that improves qualified owned-site visits while preserving the article's recipient-fit and skip conditions.
stopConditions: Stop if the concept becomes a generic product collage or implies that every golfer needs the same accessory.
Stop if source imagery, platform terms, or disclosure requirements are unresolved.

experiments.title: Trust-to-guide internal path
experiments.hypothesis: A clear path from the research standard to one relevant guide will help trust-motivated readers continue into a useful gift decision without weakening the standard page.
experiments.decisionRule: Establish a complete aggregate baseline first, then test one restrained contextual link for at least seven days; keep it only if downstream engagement improves without reducing completion of the research-standard page.
stopConditions: Stop if the link reads like a sales interruption or obscures the evidence policy.
Stop if the analytics implementation cannot distinguish aggregate page progression without personal identifiers.
